title: The US FCC opens a comment period for a proposal to help return outsourced call center jobs to the US; critics say the plan could drive companies to automation (Patience Haggin/Wall Street Journal)
summary: Patience Haggin / Wall Street Journal: The US FCC opens a comment period for a proposal to help return outsourced call center jobs to the US; critics say the plan could drive companies to automation — Analysts say the proposal, aimed to reduce fraud and language barriers, could drive companies toward automation
